title: Kalyāṇamittatā
text: 1. Sāvatthi || || 2. Ekadhammo bhikkhave bahupakāro ariyassa aṭṭhaṅgikassa maggassa uppādāya || || Katamo ekadhammo || yad idaṃ kalyāṇamittatā || || 4. Kalyāṇamittassetam bhikkhave- -maggam bahulīkaroti || || 4. Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu sammādiṭṭhim bhāveti rāgavinayapariyosānaṃ dosavinayapariyosānam mohavinayapariyosānaṃ || la || sammāsamādhim bhāveti rāga- dosa- mohavinayapariyosānaṃ || || Evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu kalyāṇamitto ariyam aṭṭhaṅgikam maggam bhāveti a- a- maggam bahulīkarotī ti || ||
